propositions: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map silently truncate at 50 issues per project due to unpaginated search_issues calls with default max_results=50
When a project has more than 50 issues, link sync reports spurious mutations and cannot detect removals; comment sync is silently incomplete
A shared _paged_search helper must be extracted and route all three callers (get_issuelinks_map, get_comment_map, get_parent_map) through it to eliminate hand-rolled pagination duplication
The pager must advance by len(batch) and terminate only on an empty page, since Jira DC silently truncates maxResults above the server limit
get_parent_map already has this fix from change 1105 but leaving it unpaginated as a fourth caller would cause the helpers to drift
